# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Age:** Twenty-one  <sub>[v1 c36 P25](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0025), [v1 c25 P61](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0061)</sub>
- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Status:** Engaged to Anne Shirley  <sub>[v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 c41 P39](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0039)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea, Prince Edward Island  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016)</sub>
- **Role:** Medical Student and former Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v3 c7 P0](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0000), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is a tall, handsome young man with broad shoulders, dark hair, and clear, straightforward eyes. In his early adolescence, he was described as having curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. As he matures into adulthood, his features acquire a more resolute, masculine strength, including a notably splendid chin.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c29 P16](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0016), [v1 c34 P12](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0012), [v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v3 c1 P43](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0043)_

## Personality

Gilbert is intelligent, ambitious, and determined, possessing a keen wit and a great capacity for earnest, honest work. He is naturally pleasant, cheerful, and good-tempered, though he exhibits a resolute, unyielding persistence when pursuing a goal. Honest, chivalrous, and patient, he holds high moral ideals and desires to leave the world better than he found it. While possessing a lively sense of humor and a teasing nature in his youth, his character develops deep sincerity and steadfast devotion, particularly toward those he loves.

_Sources: [v1 c4 P21](../source/v01-c04.md#nw-v01-c04-p0021), [v1 c15 P36](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0036), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c35 P3](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0003), [v3 c7 P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 c7 P13](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0013), [v3 c7 P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)_

## History

After returning to Avonlea from Alberta, Gilbert entered Avonlea school and immediately sparked a fierce academic rivalry with Anne Shirley after playfully calling her 'Carrots,' causing her to smash her slate over his head and refuse his apology. Despite his repeated attempts to make peace and his scholastic success at Queen's Academy, Anne maintained her grudge for years. Upon graduating from Queen's, Gilbert selflessly gave up his appointment as teacher at the Avonlea school so that Anne could remain at Green Gables with Marilla Cuthbert. After teaching at White Sands, Gilbert attended Redmond College alongside Anne, where he distinguished himself academically and athletically. He eventually proposed to Anne at Patty's Place, but she rejected him, leaving him heartbroken. Following his graduation with High Honors, Gilbert suffered a life-threatening bout of typhoid fever at his home in Avonlea. Upon his recovery, he learned that Anne had realized her true feelings during his illness, leading to their reconciliation and engagement in Hester Gray's garden.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c15 P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), [v1 c15 P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038), [v3 c3 P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011), [v3 c20 P31](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0031), [v3 c20 P36](../source/v03-c20.md#nw-v03-c20-p0036), [v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c40 P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016), [v3 c41 P24](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0024), [v3 c41 P25](../source/v03-c41.md#nw-v03-c41-p0025)_

## Background by volume

- Son of John and Mrs. Blythe  <sub>[v1 c37 P37](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0037), [v3 c39 P0](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0000)</sub>
- Lived in Alberta for three years during boyhood due to his father's ill health  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School, Queen's Academy, and Redmond College  <sub>[v1 c15 P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 c30 P20](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0020), [v3 c3 P11](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0011)</sub>
- Taught school at White Sands to earn money for college  <sub>[v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024), [v1 c38 P38](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0038)</sub>
- Won the Cooper Prize and High Honors in Classics at Redmond College  <sub>[v3 c35 P5](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0005), [v3 c39 P23](../source/v03-c39.md#nw-v03-c39-p0023)</sub>

> I want to do my share of honest, real work in the world, Anne... add a little to the sum of human knowledge that all the good men have been accumulating since it began.  <sub>[v3 c7 P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>
